primary_title: BMP2-induced apoptosis is mediated by activation of the TAK1-p38 kinase pathway that is negatively regulated by Smad6
decision_basis: Primary co-immunoprecipitation and perturbation assays support SMAD6-TAK1 association and inhibition of BMP2-TAK1-p38 signaling.
limitations_preserved: Preserve SMAD6 inhibitory interaction, BMP2-TAK1-p38 and MH60 comparator context; no receptor or terminal-TF/no-SCI inference.

primary_title: Smad7 and Smad6 bind to discrete regions of Pellino-1 via their MH2 domains to mediate TGF-beta1-induced negative regulation of IL-1R/TLR signaling
decision_basis: Primary domain-mapping and co-immunoprecipitation assays support SMAD7-Pellino1 association and inhibitory IL-1/TLR signalosome disruption.
limitations_preserved: Preserve SMAD7 MH2/Pellino-1 and TGF-beta-to-IL-1/TLR context; no direct receptor or terminal-TF/no-SCI inference.

primary_title: Akt interacts directly with Smad3 to regulate the sensitivity to TGF-beta induced apoptosis
decision_basis: Primary interaction/localization assays support AKT1 binding to unphosphorylated SMAD3 and cytoplasmic sequestration in insulin/TGF-beta crosstalk.
limitations_preserved: Preserve unphosphorylated SMAD3, insulin/PI3K and kinase-independent AKT1 context; no terminal-TF/no-SCI inference.

primary_title: Smad3 prevents beta-catenin degradation and facilitates beta-catenin nuclear translocation in chondrocytes
decision_basis: Primary co-immunoprecipitation, stability and localization assays support TGF-beta-dependent SMAD3/4-beta-catenin complex formation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve SMAD3/SMAD4 grouped complex, TGF-beta and chondrocyte context; no terminal-TF/no-SCI inference.
